title: OSCAL Report Generator - Best Practices Validation Rules
description: Comprehensive best practices and coding standards for the OSCAL Report Generator project

rules.name: No console.log in production code
rules.message: console.log statements should not be used in production code. Use proper logging instead.

rules.name: No debugger statements
rules.message: debugger statements must be removed before committing

rules.name: TODO/FIXME tracking
rules.message: TODO/FIXME comments found - consider creating GitHub issues

rules.name: Proper error handling
rules.message: Empty catch blocks should include error handling or logging

rules.name: Use async/await properly
rules.message: Async functions using await must have proper error handling

rules.name: No hardcoded secrets
rules.message: Hardcoded secrets detected! Use environment variables instead.

rules.name: No eval() usage
rules.message: eval() is dangerous and should never be used

rules.name: SQL injection prevention
rules.message: Potential SQL injection vulnerability - use parameterized queries

rules.name: XSS prevention
rules.message: Direct innerHTML assignment can lead to XSS. Use textContent or sanitize input.

rules.name: Sensitive file detection
rules.message: Sensitive file detected! These should never be committed.

rules.name: SSRF Prevention - Validate User-Supplied URLs
rules.message: CRITICAL: User-supplied URLs must be validated using validateUrl() to prevent SSRF attacks. Import from utils/urlValidator.js
rules.mitigation: Use: const urlValidation = await validateUrl(url, options); if (!urlValidation.valid) return error; axios.get(urlValidation.url)

rules.name: SSRF Prevention - No Direct fetch() with User Input
rules.message: CRITICAL: User-supplied URLs in fetch() must be validated to prevent SSRF attacks

rules.name: CSRF Protection - Require CSRF Tokens
rules.message: WARNING: State-changing endpoints (POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH) should use CSRF protection middleware
rules.mitigation: Use csrfProtection middleware or ensure endpoint is in CSRF_EXEMPT_PATHS list

rules.name: SSRF Prevention - Dangerous IP Ranges
rules.message: Hardcoded internal/private IP addresses detected. Consider using environment variables.

rules.name: Certificate Validation Disabled
rules.message: Certificate validation is disabled (rejectUnauthorized: false). This should only be used in development.
rules.mitigation: Use proper SSL certificates in production or conditionally disable based on NODE_ENV

rules.name: Function documentation
rules.message: Complex functions should have JSDoc comments

rules.name: README update check
rules.message: Consider updating README.md if you added new features

rules.name: File size limit
rules.message: Large files detected - consider optimization or Git LFS

rules.name: Line length limit
rules.message: Lines exceeding 120 characters reduce readability

rules.name: Binary files check
rules.message: Binary files detected - ensure they are necessary

rules.name: Test files for new features
rules.message: New features should include corresponding test files

rules.name: Test naming convention
rules.message: Test files should follow naming convention: *.test.js or *.spec.js

rules.name: No large commits
rules.message: Large commits are hard to review - consider breaking into smaller commits

rules.name: Commit message quality
rules.message: Commit messages should be descriptive and follow conventional commits

rules.name: No merge conflicts
rules.message: Unresolved merge conflicts detected

rules.name: Avoid synchronous operations
rules.message: Synchronous file operations can block the event loop

rules.name: Proper async patterns
rules.message: Consider using async/await instead of deep promise chains

rules.name: Package.json sync
rules.message: Version numbers must be synchronized across all package.json files

rules.name: Dependency audit
rules.message: Run npm audit regularly to check for vulnerabilities

check_async_error_handling.description: Verify async functions have try-catch blocks
check_async_error_handling.implementation: Check if async functions contain try-catch or .catch()

check_function_documentation.description: Check if exported functions have JSDoc comments
check_function_documentation.implementation: Look for /** */ comments before function declarations

check_test_coverage.description: Verify new code has accompanying tests
check_test_coverage.implementation: Check if new .js files have corresponding .test.js files

check_version_sync.implementation: Compare version fields in root, backend, and frontend package.json
